raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver step derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), but the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor and the column name both define it as the date of txn_ts. Every batch is ingested at 02:00 the day after its transactions, so the mismatch affects all POSTED rows (4630, matching the alert count), which points to a systematic wrong-column bug rather than bad data. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts and rebuilding silver and gold corrects it, though gold daily aggregates will shift to transaction-date bucketing.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.7,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
